title: no claude on PATH fails the claude check
source: intended: B4B5-DESIGN.md B4-22 and the doctor spec (defect N-20): a read-only health check
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-20, B4.5). With no `claude` on PATH doctor prints `fail claude: claude is not on PATH` and exits 3; the other checks still print. The oracle has no `doctor` command: it answers `unknown command "doctor"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every pinned line FAILS on it.

stdout.regex: (?m)^fail claude: claude is not on PATH$
